title: main: make gitCommit and hidden-flag setup non-fatal
body:
Two small startup robustness fixes:

debug.ReadBuildInfo can legitimately fail (e.g. builds that strip build info), and gitCommit() panicked on that. Returning "" only omits the commit from --version.

The registries-conf flag used MarkHidden plus a panic even though the flag is registered two lines above and the error is unreachable; switch it to the flag.Hidden = true form used everywhere else.
